geometry.backup_cells: up to max(3*k,8) deterministic cells retained for live occupation repair
geometry.door_cells: excluded from planting to preserve bank access

not_overridden.HARVEST: unchanged champion action; the orchard experiment does not reserve a fruit-harvest phase
not_overridden.TRAIN: the champion's own second TRAIN is preserved; all later TRAIN is forbidden

prefix.boundary: candidate stdout is forwarded byte-for-byte through the accepted second TRAIN; first possible override is the following turn
prefix.no_plant: always legal and represented by unchanged champion

CHOP.searched: candidate-owned orchard tree once it reaches the policy's fell size

DROP.searched: bank carried seed residue/wood before another macro

MOVE.searched: target cell for seed acquisition, planting, felling, or banking

PICK.searched: species seed from own inventory after second TRAIN

PLANT.searched: species, near-shack cell, start window, count

WAIT.searched: implicit: leave the continuously advanced champion in control while crops grow or no macro dominates

selection.primary: leave-one-map-out choice of one global policy, paired final margin
